caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair set against a plain, light beige background. The chair has an ornate backrest with curved, carved vertical slats and a decorative central splat. The top of the backrest is adorned with a carved shell motif flanked by scrolls. The seat of the chair is rectangular and upholstered in a dark, possibly black, fabric. The legs are cabriole-style with carved detailing at the knees and end in ball-and-claw feet. There are no other objects or elements in the composition. Some irregular brownish stains or patches are visible on the background near the chair.
title: Side Chair
